purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt (claims) software. It handles the handwritten-correction screen (H99) for the claims management subsystem, supporting display, entry, and confirmation of receipt correction data. It searches the claims database (tbl_seikyu), reads related master data, and manages screen navigation and field editing.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

LINKAGE SECTION driven by MCP (Message Control Program) area — event-driven screen handler pattern

verdict.notes: The file is part of the well-known open-source ORCA medical receipt system developed by JMA (Japan Medical Association). Comments are in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) but were decoded as latin-1, producing garbled characters. The program uses a proprietary MCP (Message Control Program) middleware layer for screen I/O and database access rather than CICS or raw SQL, but the overall structure and event-driven pattern is analogous to an online CICS program. Source was truncated at 16000 chars; the full file is 51548 bytes / 1296 lines.
